name: African_chamber_of_commerce
description: The African Chamber of Commerce (ACC) is a digital business ecosystem designed to connect, empower, and accelerate the growth of businesses across Africa. Rather than functioning solely as a business directory, ACC will serve as a comprehensive digital platform where businesses can establish a trusted online presence, connect with customers and strategic partners, discover new markets, access business opportunities, and utilize digital tools to improve operational efficiency. Built with Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL
author: Chimezie Victor Stephen and Chinwike Justice Stephen
